## Astraeus 2.6.2

### New
- **US Markets widget.** The S&P 500, Dow, Nasdaq, Russell 2000, VIX, NYSE Composite, NYSE American, the 10-year yield, gold and oil, each with a small chart and its change, plus whether the market is open, in pre-market, after hours or closed. Click it for every market at once, and add any ticker you like.
- **NYSE American widget,** with the index's chart for the day.
- **Sports widgets: Scores and Fixtures.** Follow up to three of nearly 50 leagues: football, F1 and motorsport, basketball, American football, baseball, hockey, cricket, rugby, tennis, golf, MMA, chess and more, with men's and women's competitions named as such. **Scores** shows live games and the latest results; scroll over it to go through them, and click it for every score with its periods and venue. **Fixtures** shows what's live, the latest results and what's coming up, grouped by day in your own time zone.
- **Add a game to your calendar.** In the Fixtures panel, **Add** puts a coming game in Astraeus' calendar, with no calendar account needed. It then reads **Remove**, to take it back out. Open its day in the calendar to see it, and remove it there too.
- **Every widget opens for more.** Click any widget for its details. They open smoothly, growing out of the widget. Weather opens the forecast, and stocks open their chart with the day's numbers.
- **Market and score items for the pills.** The regular pill can show the S&P 500. The long pill can show it too, and a live score, like "BAR 0-1 RMA". Scroll over the score to go through the games. The score item is offered while a Scores or Fixtures widget is on your Widgets page.
- **Pick the pill for each place.** On the desktop and when not on the desktop, choose the regular pill or the long one, in Settings or right in the long pill's editor. A regular pill on the desktop with the long one over your apps works too.
- **Different long pill items when not on the desktop.** Turn on **Own widgets** on the editor's **Not on desktop** tab, and the long pill keeps one set of items on the desktop and another over your apps. It's off until you switch it on.
- **Right-click the regular pill to customize.** It opens the long pill's editor. If neither place uses the long pill yet, it asks first.

### Better
- **The long pill is now the desktop pill for everyone.** If you used the regular pill on the desktop, you'll see a short note about the change once, and **Switch back** puts the regular pill back. You can also change it any time under **Long pill** in Settings. If you already used the long pill, nothing changes, and with **Pill on the desktop** off there's still no pill on your desktop.
- **The long pill's editor is tidier:** the place, the pill it wears there and your undo, reset and done sit in one row along the top.
- **Long panels scroll all the way down,** so the last row is never cut off.

### Fixed
- The theme no longer flips while the panel is open and you switch windows.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
